name: Hyena Warrior
bio: Laughs at everything, especially the last thing you tried.
notes: Digitigrade: the leg joints sit on the leg's centre line (read off a side profile), so straightening it turns the thigh and shin only a little and the knee doesn't fold; the hock is the ankle, the paw the foot. Its model replaced 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b, the owner's mapping) by "Gnoll warrior" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used); it was built from the owner's own model.
